entities.summary: The Beast of Gévaudan is the historic name associated with a man-eating animal or animals that terrorized the former province of Gévaudan, in the Margeride Mountains of south-central France between 1764 and 1767. Jean Chastel was a scientists & inventors from La Besseyre-Saint-Mary (1708-03-31, La Besseyre-Saint-Mary–1789-03-06).
